item.title: Deep-Learning Aided Channel Training and Precoding in FDD Massive MIMO with Channel Statistics Knowledge
item.description: We propose a method for channel training and precoding in FDD massive MIMO based on deep neural networks, exploiting Downlink channel covariance knowledge.
